hazards.evidence: Handrail is present on the left side of the stairs but missing on the right side, leaving one side without support for a walker user.
The right-side handrail appears to be a loose wooden pole, not securely mounted or continuous, making it unreliable for support.
White tape or debris is visible on multiple stair treads, creating tripping hazards for someone using a walker.
Only one small ceiling light is visible at the top of the stairs, providing inadequate illumination for safe navigation, especially at night.
The stair carpet appears worn and bunched, with undefined edges and possible loose sections, increasing fall risk.
A black electrical cord runs diagonally across the floor from the left wall toward the stairs, creating a tripping hazard.
The overall lighting is dim, with shadows and low contrast, which can impair depth perception and increase fall risk.
